sources.note: Main landing page. Company overview: medical billing, EHR, practice management since 1982. Serves NJ/NY/PA. Products: AuroraEHR, Rexpert, billing services, transcription, practice development.

AuroraEHR product page. Features: point-and-click templates, traditional chart flow, drug interactions, iPad app (CPT/ICD-10, vitals, photos, consents), interoperability, document management (PDF/JPG/Word/TIF/GIF/BMP), patient portal, integration with Rexpert.

ONC mandatory disclosures page. Certification details for AuroraEHR v2.1 (12/27/2022). Lists 45 certified functionalities. Pricing mentions monthly support fee, monthly patient portal fee, one-time setup/training/implementation/license fee. Supports 9 clinical quality measures.
About page. Over 500 doctors, 70+ specialties, solo to hospital systems. 80+ years combined team experience. Headquartered Tinton Falls, NJ.
Rexpert product page. Advanced scheduler, medical billing, eligibility verification, patient recalls, 300+ customizable reports, RIS functionality, automatic backup.

Medical billing services page. Managed billing service: patient data review, diagnosis/procedure code verification, unpaid claims tracking, web-based payments. Bundles free practice management software. Serves 40+ specialties.
LinkedIn company page. 11-50 employees, 21 on LinkedIn, 69 followers. Partnership type. Industry: Hospitals and Health Care. Located Red Bank/Tinton Falls, NJ.
SoftwareFinder page for Aurora EHR alternatives. Returned HTTP 410 (gone), suggesting the listing has been removed/delisted.
Yelp listing for Practice Alternatives at 4000 Rt 66, Tinton Falls, NJ. Categorized as Business Consulting. Found via search but not fetched in detail.
TrustRadius listing for Rexpert. Found via search but not fetched — indicates Rexpert has some third-party review presence even if AuroraEHR does not.
